_note: Hand-authored singable English for 许嵩《天龙八部之宿敌》. Keyed by the Chinese line so every repeat inherits one translation. Syllable count must equal the Chinese character count, which equals the note count.
title: Nemesis (宿敌) - English singable version

lines.会在何处见到你: Where will I find you again
lines.莫非前尘已注定: Is it the fate that was made
lines.却囿于刀剑光影: Trapped in the light of the blades
lines.三月春花渐次醒: March wakes the flowers in spring
lines.迢迢年华谁老去: Who is still young through the years
lines.是劫是缘随我心: Curse or a blessing, I choose
lines.除了你万敌不侵: No one can hurt me but you
lines.当恩怨各一半: When love and hate are one
lines.当天上星河转: When the stars all come down
lines.待绝笔墨痕干: Wait till the ink is gone
lines.缠扰孤岛的雪雨: Snow and rain beat on my isle
lines.摘取一颗海上星: I pick one star from the sea
lines.陪我终夜不孤寂: Stay through the night here with me
lines.灵柩长埋深谷底: Coffins lie deep in the clay
lines.染指江湖结悲局: Touching the world ends in grief
lines.无人逃得过宿命: No one escapes from their fate
